model_explanation: S1 says the only thing Sam gave Bill was bananas; S2 says Bill also got grapes, which contradicts that.
S1 restricts what Mary got (only apples), not whether others got apples; S2 is about Ellen.
S1 restricts what Sue got (only apples), not whether others got apples; S2 is about Tom.
if Bill got only grapes from Sam, then he did not get oranges from Sam.
if Bill got only apples from Sam, then he did not get bananas from Sam.
if Sue got only apples from Sam, then she did not get bananas from Sam.
S1 restricts what Ellen got, not who else (e.g., Tom) got oranges.
S1 restricts what Tom got, not whether Mary got apples.
S1 restricts what Tom got, not whether Bill got apples.
S1 restricts what Sue got, not whether Tom got bananas.
